title: Analysis reproduction for Claim 3 (reproducibility tax separates subfields, AUC=0.91)
notes: Covers reproducing the ANALYSIS only: recomputing per-subfield tau (log1p of compute_gpu_hours + 24*wall_time_days + person_hours, averaged per subfield) and the Mann-Whitney ROC AUC of the scalar budget as a vision+nlp vs tabular discriminator, from the logged 312-paper audit table (schema documented in repro/analysis.py; JSON result on stdout; expected AUC ~= 0.91). The audit table is not yet published as a standalone dataset -- see the paper's open question 'Calibration record as common pool' -- so this manifest is a pinned recipe awaiting its data release. The weighting is the one documented in the paper's Approach section; Claim 3's robustness statement covers the linear / log-linear / sum-of-fields family, and this entrypoint recomputes only the documented default. The environment digest is left null rather than fabricated; pin it when the data ships.
